chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hashimi al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Furat ibn Ibrahim ibn Furat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Thahir narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, the nephew of Yunus al-Baghdadi, narrated to us in Baghdad. He said: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Nahshili narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Musa al-Rida narrated to us from his father Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), from Gabriel, from Michael, from Israfil, from Allah the Mighty and Majestic, that He said:

I am Allah, there is no god but Me. I created the creation with My power. I selected from among them whomever I wished from My prophets, and I selected from all of them Muhammad as My Beloved, My Friend, and My Chosen One. I sent him as a messenger to My creation. I chose Ali for him, and I made him his brother, his successor, his vizier, and his representative to My creation after him. He is My vicegerent over My servants, so that he may clarify My Book to them and govern among them by My judgment. I made him the guiding sign from misguidance, My gate from which I am approached, My house — whoever enters it is safe from My Fire, My fortress — whoever seeks refuge in it is protected from the hateful things of this world and the Hereafter, My Face — whoever turns toward it, I shall not turn My Face away from him, and My proof in the heavens and the earths over all of My creatures therein. I shall not accept the deed of any doer among them unless they acknowledge his authority alongside the prophethood of Ahmad, My Messenger. He is My extended hand over My servants. He is the blessing with which I have blessed those whom I love among My servants. Whoever I love among My servants and take as a guardian, I make him recognize his authority and his knowledge. Whoever I hate among My servants, I hate him for his turning away from his knowledge and his authority. By My Might I have sworn, and by My Majesty I have vowed: No servant from among My servants shall align with Ali except that I shall displace him from the Fire and enter him into Paradise; and no servant from among My servants shall hate him and turn away from his authority except that I shall hate him and enter him into the Fire — and wretched is the destination.

key_terms.حجة: divine proof and argument over creation
key_terms.حديث قدسي: sacred narration in which Allah speaks in the first person, transmitted through the Prophet
key_terms.خليفة: vicegerent, successor appointed by divine authority
key_terms.سلسلة الذهب: golden chain - the unbroken chain of transmission through all twelve Imams
key_terms.ولاية: divine authority and guardianship bestowed upon Ali

ai.seo_question: What is the golden chain (silsilat al-dhahab) hadith about Ali?
ai.summary: A hadith qudsi transmitted through the famous 'golden chain' (silsilat al-dhahab) — from Allah through the archangels Israfil, Michael, and Gabriel, to the Prophet Muhammad, then through all twelve Shia Imams descending from Ali ibn Abi Talib back to Imam Ali al-Rida. In this divine narration, Allah declares His selection of Muhammad as Prophet and Ali as his divinely appointed successor (wali). Allah describes Ali through a series of magnificent titles: His gate, His house of safety, His fortress, His face, and His proof over all creation. Allah swears by His might and majesty that whoever accepts Ali's authority will be saved from the Fire, and whoever rejects it will face divine wrath. The hadith was reported at the assembly (amali) of Shaykh al-Saduq, one of the greatest Shia hadith scholars of the 4th/10th century, and represents one of the most elevated chains of transmission in Islamic hadith literature.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. Sa`id al-Hashimi al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Furat b. Ibrahim b. Furat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Thahir narrated to us. He said: Abu’l Hasan Muhammad b. al-Husayn the nephew of Yunus al-Baghdadi narrated to us in Baghdad. He said: Muhammad b. Ya`qub al-Nahshili narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Musa al-Rida narrated to us from his father Musa b. Ja`far from his father Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) from the Prophet (s) from Gabriel from Michael from Israfil from Allah.  He said:

I am Allah – there is no god but Me. I created the creation with My power. I selected whomever I wished to be My prophets from among them. I selected Muhammad from all of them to be My Beloved, My Friend, and My elite one. I sent him as a Messenger to My creation. I chose `Ali for him, and I made him his brother, his deputy, his vizier, and his representative to My creation after him. He is My vicegerent over My servants, who clarifies My Book to them and applies My judgment among them. I have made him the sign that guides from misguidance, My gate from which I am come to, My house – whoever enters it is safe from My Fire, My fortress – whoever seeks refuge in it is protected from the hateful things of this world and the Hereafter, My Face – whoever faces it, I will not turn My Face away from, and My Proof in the heavens and the Earths over all that is in them of my creatures. I will not accept the deeds of any of them unless they declare his wilaya alongside the prophethood of Ahmad, My Messenger. He is My open hand over My servants. He is the blessing by which I bless those who I love from among My servants. Whoever I love from among My servants, I make him recognize him and his wilaya. Whoever I hate from My servants. I make him not recognize him and his wilaya. I swear by My glory and I vow by My majesty: surely, no servant from My servants will align with `Ali except that I will displace him from the Fire and enter him into Paradise; and no servant from My servants will hate him and reject his wilaya except that I will hate him and enter him into the Fire in the misery of fate.
